name: Byterover
description_en:
ByteRover gives coding agents durable project memory organized into spaces. Its V4 workflow uses a Desktop application for teams, sharing and connected agents, while a skill inside the agent queries and records decisions, conventions and debugging knowledge. It supplies context rather than independently implementing and verifying a software change.

Local-first storage and optional sharing need to be assessed together: the active space determines what an agent reads and where new memory goes. A private space can later be shared, including outside its owning team.
description_zh:
ByteRover 按空间为编程 Agent 提供持久项目记忆。V4 流程通过桌面应用管理团队、共享及连接的 Agent，由 Agent 内的 skill 查询和记录决策、约定及调试知识。它提供上下文，本身不等同于独立实施并验证软件改动。

本地优先存储与可选共享需一起评估：当前空间决定 Agent 读什么、将新记忆写到哪里；私人空间后续也可共享，包括共享给所属团队以外的人。

sections.title_en: Query before work and record the decision afterward
sections.title_zh: 工作前查询，完成后记录决策
sections.en:
The V4 overview starts with Desktop installation, Google or GitHub sign-in, agent connection and project onboarding. Manual skill setup requires Node.js 20 or later. Query runs inside the project folder so it can resolve the intended space; its result can include topic paths, snippets and source links.

A hypothetical trial could ask for the project’s test strategy, inspect the returned topic, make a separate reviewed decision and record its reason. Then query that topic from a new session. The Record guide advises saving useful decisions rather than duplicating facts already obvious from code or Git history. These steps were not executed here.
sections.zh:
V4 概述从安装 Desktop、Google 或 GitHub 登录、连接 Agent 及项目入门开始，手动配置 skill 需 Node.js 20 或更高版本。Query 在项目目录内运行以解析目标空间，结果可包含主题路径、片段及来源链接。

假设试用可查询项目测试策略，查看返回主题，另外作出经核对的决策并记录理由，再从新会话查询。Record 指南建议保存有用决策，而非重复代码或 Git 历史已清楚呈现的事实。本文未执行这些步骤。

sections.title_en: Space selection is a permission boundary
sections.title_zh: 空间选择构成权限边界
sections.en:
The spaces guide distinguishes Private, Team space and Shared with me. Only Owners and Admins create team spaces. A Viewer can query but cannot record; Editor, Admin and Owner roles carry different write and sharing rights. General access can expand a restricted space to the owning team, and direct invitations can cross team boundaries.

Check the active space before asking an agent to save client-specific context. A successful recall is not proof that the memory is current or correct: Query explicitly asks users to inspect sources and resolve conflicts with the current task. Test both an authorized recall and a denied write before sharing operational knowledge.
sections.zh:
空间指南区分 Private、Team space、Shared with me，仅 Owner 和 Admin 可新建团队空间。Viewer 可查询但不可记录，Editor、Admin、Owner 的写入和共享权利不同。通用访问可将受限空间扩展至所属团队，直接邀请则可跨团队。

让 Agent 保存客户相关上下文前应确认当前空间。查询成功不能证明记忆最新或正确，Query 明确要求查看来源并解决与当前任务冲突。共享运营知识前，应测试一次授权查询和一次被拒写入。

sections.title_en: Count synced context files and verify the billing unit
sections.title_zh: 统计同步文件并核对计费单位
sections.en:
The page offers Free with 100 cloud-synced context files and team collaboration, Pro at USD 15/month billed yearly with unlimited context files, and a custom Enterprise plan listing SSO/SAML, RBAC and on-premise deployment. The static monthly panel repeats Free rather than exposing a reliable Pro monthly rate. No separate monthly Pro price is asserted.

The page does not clearly establish whether the Pro price applies per seat, team or account, so do not multiply it into a team invoice without confirmation. The homepage claims MIT licensing, but no repository license was inspected; legal license status stays unverified. This research also did not audit cloud privacy, recall quality or cross-agent compatibility.
sections.zh:
价格页提供 Free，含 100 个云同步上下文文件和团队协作；Pro 按年付月均 15 美元、不限文件；Enterprise 询价，列 SSO／SAML、RBAC 及本地部署。静态月付面板重复 Free，没有可靠 Pro 月付费率，本文不声明独立月付价。

页面未清楚确定 Pro 按席位、团队还是账户计费，不能直接算成团队账单。首页称 MIT 许可，但本文未查仓库许可证，法律许可状态仍未核实；也未审计云隐私、查询质量或跨 Agent 兼容性。
